title: Offer your services.
subtitle: Werde einer der Anbieter, die in Maputo, Matola und Beira Kundschaft finden. Keine monatliche Gebühr — nur ein fester Prozentsatz von dem, was du verdienst, angezeigt, bevor du inserierst.
pathsBlurb: Pick one to start with. You can change later — what differs is how the calendar and the team work.

individual.title: On your own
individual.body: You are the service: your profile, your prices, the hours you choose. Work at the customer's, at your place, or remote.

organization.title: A business with staff
organization.body: Several staff under one name, with bookings running in parallel as people are free. Invite your team and set what each can do.
organization.tag: One calendar per member of staff

pricingBody: Der Kunde zahlt genau den Preis, den du festlegst. Der Anteil der Plattform wird von dem abgezogen, was du ausgezahlt bekommst — ein fester Prozentsatz, angezeigt, bevor du eine Leistung veröffentlichst, und nie eine Überraschung bei der Auszahlung.

apply.title: Apply
apply.body: Create the account and tell us what you do and where. It takes a few minutes.

review.title: Verification
review.body: We confirm who you are before showing you to customers. It is what makes the verified badge mean something.

publish.title: Publish services
publish.body: Prices, duration and availability. Bookable slots are generated for you.

earn.title: Get paid
earn.body: Payment is held until the job is done, then released to you.

identity.title: Proof of identity
identity.body: An ID card, passport or driving licence, so we can confirm you are who you say.

payout.title: A way to be paid
payout.body: M-Pesa, e-Mola or a bank account. It is where your earnings go.

terms.title: Accept the terms
terms.body: The platform's rules, including what happens when a booking goes wrong.

stepsEyebrow: From signing up to your first booking
closingBody: Joining is free, and there is nothing to pay until your first booking.
